body_lead: Kerala Launches AI-Led Governance Initiative Kerala launched an AI-led governance initiative on 4 August 2026 to integrate artificial intelligence, digital public service delivery, and integrated planning systems in state administration. The reforms include a central programme management unit, an AI-enabled business process re-engineering cell, a “once-only” document submission framework through DigiLocker, and digital systems for land, litigation, and public asset management.
